_comment: Tourist visa destination requirements for all 199 countries in passport-index.json. Fields: fee (typical cost), maxStay (days), processingTime, evisaAvailable, voaAvailable, docs (required documents), notes. Source: Compiled from official government sources & IATA TIMATIC. For tourist/visitor purposes only.
_disclaimer: Requirements vary by nationality. Always verify with the official embassy before travel.

AD.notes: No separate Andorra visa; entry via France/Spain border.

AE.notes: Visa-free for 60+ nationalities. VoA available at Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah airports.

AF.notes: Most governments advise against travel to Afghanistan.

AG.notes: Visa-free for Commonwealth, EU, and US citizens.

docs: Valid passport or EU ID card
AL.notes: EU, US, UK, and most European citizens enter visa-free. Annual summer tourist waiver in effect.

AM.notes: e-Visa available at evisa.mfa.am. VoA also at Zvartnots Airport.

AR.notes: Visa-free for most nationalities (EU, US, UK, Canada, etc.). Extendable up to 180 days.

AT.notes: Schengen visa; 90 days in any 180-day period within Schengen Area.

AU.notes: eVisitor (free for eligible EU/UK) or ETA (AUD 20) online. Tourist visa (subclass 600) AUD 150 for others.

AZ.notes: e-Visa at evisa.gov.az. 90-day e-visa also available.

BA.notes: Visa-free for EU, US, UK, Schengen passport holders. 90 days.

BB.notes: Visa-free for Commonwealth, EU, and US citizens.

BD.notes: e-Visa at evisa.immigration.gov.bd. VoA at Dhaka airport for some nationalities.

BE.notes: Schengen visa. Apply at Belgian embassy or consulate.

BF.notes: Visa required for most nationalities. Check travel advisories.

BG.notes: Bulgaria joined Schengen (air/sea) in 2024. Schengen visa valid for Bulgaria.

BH.notes: e-Visa at evisa.gov.bh. VoA also available at Bahrain International Airport.

BI.notes: VoA available at Bujumbura International Airport.

BJ.notes: e-Visa at evisa.gouv.bj. VoA also available at Cotonou Airport.

BN.notes: Visa-free for ASEAN, Commonwealth, EU, US. Others may require a visa.

BO.notes: Visa-free for US, EU, and most Latin American countries. VoA for others at main border posts.

BR.notes: e-Visa available free at formulario.casacivil.gov.br. Previously charged US, Canada, Australia — now free. Extendable to 180 days/year.

BS.notes: Visa-free for Commonwealth, EU, US, and Canadian citizens.

BT.notes: All tourists must book through a licensed Bhutanese tour operator. SDF (Sustainable Development Fee) mandatory.

BW.notes: Visa-free for most Commonwealth, EU, US, and Southern African countries. 90 days.

BY.notes: e-Visa available for eligible nationalities via mfa.gov.by. Visa-free transit through Minsk airport for 30 days for many nationalities.

BZ.notes: Visa-free for Commonwealth, EU, US, and Caribbean nations.

CA.notes: eTA (CAD $7) for visa-exempt nationals flying in. Visitor visa (TRV) for others at ircc.canada.ca.

CD.notes: Visa required for all nationalities. Apply at DRC embassy or consulate.

CF.notes: Visa required for all. Travel advisory warning in effect for most of the country.

CH.notes: Schengen visa (issued by Switzerland). 90 days in any 180-day period.

CL.notes: Visa-free for most nationalities. 90 days per entry, extendable.

CM.notes: e-Visa system recently introduced at evisacameroon.com.

CN.notes: 144-hour/72-hour visa-free transit policy at many major airports. L-visa (tourist) required for most. Apply at Chinese consulate.

CO.notes: Visa-free for US, EU, UK, and most nationalities. Up to 180 days/year.

CR.notes: Visa-free for US, EU, Canadian, and most Latin American citizens.

CU.notes: Tourist card (tarjeta del turista) required for all. Available from airline or at airport. Extensions possible.

CV.notes: EASE (Electronic Authorization System for Entry) at ease.gov.cv for all visitors.

CY.notes: Not yet in Schengen. Visa-free for EU. e-Visa for others at evisa.moi.gov.cy.

DE.notes: Schengen visa. Apply at German embassy/consulate. 90 days in 180-day period.

DJ.notes: e-Visa available at evisa.gouv.dj. VoA also at Djibouti-Ambouli Airport.

DM.notes: Visa-free for Commonwealth, EU, US, and Caribbean nations.

DO.notes: Tourist card ($10) available on arrival or included in airfare. Extendable. Most nationalities welcome.

DZ.notes: Tourist visa required for most nationalities. Apply at Algerian embassy.

EC.notes: Visa-free for most nationalities. 90 days extendable. Galapagos transit card required ($20).

EG.notes: e-Visa at visa2egypt.gov.eg. VoA also available at Cairo, Luxor, Alexandria, and Hurghada airports.

ER.notes: Tourism visa very restrictive. Travel permit required within Eritrea. Limited entry points.

ES.notes: Schengen visa. Apply at Spanish consulate.

ET.notes: e-Visa at www.evisa.gov.et. VoA at Addis Ababa Bole Airport. 90-day visa also available.

FJ.notes: Visa-free on arrival for most nationalities. 120 days.

FM.notes: Visa-free for many nationalities. Entry permit issued on arrival.

FR.notes: Schengen visa. 90 days in 180-day period. Apply at French consulate.

GB.notes: Standard Visitor Visa. Visa-free for US, EU, and many other nationalities. ETA (£10) required from 2024 for US, EU, Canadian visitors.

GD.notes: Visa-free for Commonwealth, EU, US, and most Caribbean nations.

GE.notes: Visa-free for most European, US, and many other nationalities (1 year). e-Visa for others at evisa.gov.ge.

GH.notes: e-Visa at visa.gov.gh. ECOWAS citizens visa-free.

GM.notes: VoA available at Banjul Airport. ECOWAS citizens visa-free.

GQ.notes: Tourism visa difficult to obtain. Invitation from a local company or hotel often required.

GT.notes: Visa-free for US, EU, and many other nationalities. CA-4 agreement: Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua share 90-day regional entry.

GY.notes: VoA available for some CARICOM nationals. Others apply at embassy.

HK.notes: Visa-free for 170+ nationalities (7–180 days depending on passport). Very open to tourism.

HN.notes: CA-4 agreement; 90 days for US, EU, and many other nationalities across Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua.

HR.notes: Croatia joined Schengen in 2023. Schengen visa valid.

HT.notes: Tourist card available on arrival for $10. Check travel advisories before visiting.

ID.notes: VoA ($35) at major airports including Bali, Jakarta, Surabaya. Visa-free for ASEAN nations. e-Visa also available. Extendable for 30 more days.

IE.notes: Not Schengen. Visa-free for EU, US, UK, and many other nationalities. Apply via AVATS system.

IL.notes: Visa-free for most Western nationalities on arrival. Israel border officials may deny entry; have clear itinerary.

IN.notes: e-Visa at indianvisaonline.gov.in: 30-day ($25), 1-year ($40), 5-year ($80) tourist e-Visa. Most nationalities eligible. Nepal & Bhutan citizens enter free.

IQ.notes: e-Visa available for some nationalities. Kurdistan Region has separate entry. Check travel advisories.

IR.notes: US, UK, and Canadian citizens cannot enter as independent tourists. e-Visa via e-visa.mfa.ir. VoA at Tehran airport for eligible nationalities.

IS.notes: Part of Schengen. 90 days in 180-day period. Visa-free for EU, US, UK, and many others.

IT.notes: Schengen visa. Apply at Italian consulate. 90 days in 180-day period.

JM.notes: Visa-free for Commonwealth, EU, US, and CARICOM nationals.

JO.notes: Jordan Pass (JOD 70-80) includes entry visa and 40+ attractions. VoA at Queen Alia Airport. Aqaba is a free economic zone with free entry.

JP.notes: Visa-free for 68+ nationalities (up to 90 days). Others: tourist visa free of charge at Japanese embassy. Single or multiple entry.

KE.notes: e-Visa mandatory for all at etakenya.go.ke. ETA (Electronic Travel Authorization) required.

KG.notes: e-Visa at evisa.e-gov.kg. Visa-free for CIS, EU, US, and many other nationalities.

KH.notes: e-Visa at evisa.gov.kh. VoA ($30) available at Phnom Penh and Siem Reap airports.

KI.notes: Visa required for most nationalities. Limited tourist infrastructure.

KM.notes: Visa on arrival free for all nationalities.

KN.notes: Visa-free for Commonwealth, EU, US, and CARICOM nationals.

KP.notes: Only accessible via authorized tour operators. US citizens generally not permitted. Independent travel not allowed.

KR.notes: K-ETA ($10) required for visa-exempt nationalities. Visa-free for 100+ nationalities (30–90 days). e-Visa at visa.go.kr for others.

KW.notes: e-Visa available for eligible nationalities at evisa.moi.gov.kw. Others apply at embassy.

KZ.notes: e-Visa at evisa.mfa.kz. Visa-free for many European, American, and Asian nationals.

LA.notes: e-Visa at laoevisa.gov.la. VoA ($35) at Vientiane, Luang Prabang, and Pakse airports. ASEAN visa-free.

LB.notes: VoA available for many nationalities. Israeli passport holders denied entry. Check latest entry requirements.

LC.notes: Visa-free for Commonwealth, EU, US, and CARICOM nationals.

LI.notes: Apply for Swiss or other Schengen visa. Liechtenstein is part of the Schengen Area.

LK.notes: ETA (Electronic Travel Authorization) at eta.gov.lk. $20 + $5 service fee. Extendable up to 6 months.

LR.notes: ECOWAS citizens visa-free. Others apply at Liberian embassy.

LS.notes: VoA free for most nationalities. 14 days, extendable. Located within South Africa.

LY.notes: Tourist visa extremely difficult to obtain. Most governments advise against travel to Libya.

MA.notes: Visa-free for EU, US, UK, many Arab, and other nationalities (90 days). Others apply at Moroccan embassy.

MC.notes: No separate Monaco visa. Entered via France; Schengen visa valid.

MD.notes: e-Visa at evisa.gov.md. Visa-free for EU, US, UK, and many others.

ME.notes: Visa-free for EU, US, UK, and many other nationalities. 90 days.

MG.notes: VoA available at Ivato Airport and other entry points. $35 (30 days), $55 (60 days), $85 (90 days). e-Visa also available.

MH.notes: Visa-free for most nationalities. Entry permit on arrival.

MK.notes: Visa-free for EU, US, UK, and many nationalities. EU candidate country.

ML.notes: ECOWAS citizens visa-free. Check travel advisories before visiting.

MM.notes: e-Visa at evisa.moip.gov.mm. Check travel advisories due to political situation.

MN.notes: e-Visa at evisa.mn. Visa-free for many nationalities. 90-day visa also available.

MO.notes: Visa-free for most nationalities. Up to 30–180 days depending on passport.

MR.notes: e-Visa available. VoA also at Nouakchott airport.

MU.notes: Visa-free for most nationalities. Tourist permit on arrival (60–90 days).

MV.notes: Visa on arrival free for all nationalities. 30 days extendable.

MW.notes: VoA free for Commonwealth, SADC, and many other nationals. Others $75 at embassy.

MX.notes: Visa-free for most nationalities. FMM tourist card issued on arrival (free at land borders, included in airline fare).

MY.notes: Visa-free for most nationalities (30–90 days). eNTRI ($15) for some nationalities. eVISA for others.

MZ.notes: e-Visa at evisa.gov.mz. VoA at Maputo airport and major border posts.

NA.notes: Visa-free for most Western, Commonwealth, and SADC nations.

NE.notes: ECOWAS citizens visa-free. Check travel advisories.

NG.notes: e-Visa via Nigeria Immigration Service portal. ECOWAS citizens visa-free.

NI.notes: Tourist card ($10) paid on arrival. CA-4 agreement: 90 days across Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua.

NO.notes: Schengen visa (Norway, not EU but Schengen). 90 days in 180-day period.

NP.notes: Tourist visa on arrival at Kathmandu airport. $25 (15 days), $40 (30 days), $100 (90 days). e-Visa at online.nepalimmigration.gov.np.

NR.notes: Very limited tourist facilities. Visa required for most nationalities.

NZ.notes: NZeTA ($17 NZD) for visa-waiver nationalities. Visitor Visa (NZD 246) for others. Apply at immigration.govt.nz.

OM.notes: e-Visa at evisa.rop.gov.om. Multiple entry and extended options available.

PA.notes: Visa-free for most nationalities (US, EU, etc.) up to 180 days. Others apply at embassy.

PE.notes: Visa-free for most nationalities. Up to 183 days.

PG.notes: VoA available at Port Moresby airport for most nationalities.

PH.notes: Visa-free for most nationalities on arrival. Initial 30 days; extendable up to 3 years.

PK.notes: e-Visa at visa.nadra.gov.pk. Tourism e-Visa available for 100+ nationalities.

PS.notes: Access via Israel (Ben Gurion Airport, Jordan border crossings) or Egypt (Rafah crossing). Subject to Israeli entry rules.

PW.notes: Visa-free for most Western nationalities. VoA for others.

PY.notes: Visa-free for Mercosur countries and many others. 90 days.

QA.notes: Visa-free for 100+ nationalities. Free Hayya card for others. VoA at Hamad International Airport.

RO.notes: Romania joined Schengen air/sea in 2024. Schengen visa valid. Romanian national visa for others.

RS.notes: Visa-free for EU, US, UK, Schengen holders, and many others. 90 days.

RU.notes: e-Visa ($52) for 16-day single-entry. Tourist visa requires invitation. Check government travel advisories.

RW.notes: e-Visa at irembo.gov.rw. VoA also at Kigali airport. EAC e-Visa covers Rwanda, Kenya, Uganda.

SA.notes: Tourist e-Visa available for 60+ nationalities at visa.visitsaudi.com. Includes multi-entry, 1-year validity.

SB.notes: Commonwealth nationals often visa-free on arrival. Others apply at embassy.

SC.notes: Visitor's Permit free for all nationalities on arrival. Extendable up to 3 months.

SD.notes: Tourist visa difficult to obtain. Many governments advise against travel.

SG.notes: Visa-free for 160+ nationalities. 30–90 days on arrival. Very open to tourism.

SL.notes: e-Visa available at evisa.sl.gov. ECOWAS citizens visa-free.

SM.notes: No border controls with Italy. Use Italian or Schengen visa if required.

SN.notes: Visa-free for EU, US, UK, and many nationalities (90 days). ECOWAS citizens visa-free.

SO.notes: Most governments advise against travel. Somaliland (de facto independent) has its own entry.

SS.notes: Check travel advisories before visiting South Sudan.

SV.notes: CA-4 agreement. Most nationalities enter visa-free. Tourist card $10.

SY.notes: Most governments strongly advise against travel to Syria. Limited entry options.

SZ.notes: Visa-free for Commonwealth, SADC, EU, and US citizens. Others apply at embassy.

TD.notes: Tourist visa required for most nationalities. Limited tourist infrastructure.

TG.notes: e-Visa at evisa.gouv.tg. VoA also available. ECOWAS citizens visa-free.

TH.notes: Visa-free for 60+ nationalities (30–60 days). VoA ($35) for others. e-Visa available at thaievisa.go.th. Extendable 30 days at immigration office.

TJ.notes: e-Visa at evisa.tj (includes GBAO permit). CIS citizens visa-free.

TL.notes: VoA available for all nationalities at Dili Airport and Dili seaport.

docs: Invitation letter from approved tour company
TM.notes: Visa required for almost all nationalities. Must use government-approved tour operator. Very restricted.

TN.notes: Visa-free for EU, US, UK, Arab League, and many other nationalities.

TO.notes: VoA free or $50 on arrival. 31 days.

TR.notes: e-Visa at evisa.gov.tr. Visa-free for EU, UK, Japan, and many other nationalities. Extendable up to 90 days in 180-day period.

TT.notes: Visa-free for Commonwealth, EU, US, and CARICOM nationals.

TV.notes: One of the world's least-visited countries. Visa-free on arrival for most nationalities.

TW.notes: Visa-free for US, EU, UK, Japan, Australia, and 60+ others (30–90 days). e-Visa for others at visawebapp.boca.gov.tw.

TZ.notes: e-Visa mandatory at eservices.immigration.go.tz. Single ($50), multiple entry ($100), or EAC e-Visa ($100 covers Uganda and Rwanda).

UA.notes: e-Visa available. Visa-free for EU, US, UK, and many others. Check travel advisories due to ongoing conflict.

UG.notes: e-Visa at visas.immigration.go.ug. EAC e-Visa covers Uganda, Kenya, and Rwanda ($100).

US.notes: ESTA ($21) for VWP countries (90 days). B-1/B-2 Visitor Visa ($185) for others — expect long wait times at US embassies.

UY.notes: Visa-free for most nationalities. 90 days extendable.

UZ.notes: e-Visa at e-visa.uz. Visa-free for 90+ nationalities. Single and multiple entry options.

VA.notes: No separate Vatican visa. Open to tourists daily (except Sunday mass). Enter from Rome with Italian/Schengen visa.

VC.notes: Visa-free for Commonwealth, EU, US, and CARICOM nationals.

VE.notes: Visa-free for many Latin American nations. Others apply at embassy. Check travel advisories.

VN.notes: e-Visa at evisa.xuatnhapcanh.gov.vn. Visa-free for EU, UK, Australia, and many others (15–90 days). Single and multiple entry.

VU.notes: Visa-free for all nationalities on arrival. 30 days extendable.

WS.notes: Entry Permit (ETA) required for all at samoavisa.ws.

docs: Valid passport or EU ID card
XK.notes: Visa-free for EU, US, UK, Schengen holders, and most Western nationalities. €10 entry fee for others on arrival.

YE.notes: Most governments strongly advise against travel to Yemen.

docs: Yellow fever vaccination (if from endemic country)
ZA.notes: Visa-free for US, EU, UK, and many nationalities. 90 days.

ZM.notes: KAZA UniVisa ($50) covers Zambia and Zimbabwe. e-Visa at eservices.zambiaimmigration.gov.zm.

docs: Yellow fever vaccination (if from endemic country)
ZW.notes: KAZA UniVisa ($55) covers Zimbabwe and Zambia. e-Visa at evisa.zim.gov.zw.
